answer: Voyage-vouching: each new identity must complete a 5-hop voyage through unrelated verifier nodes, costing $20 in non-refundable hop fees plus 2.5 hours of time-locked puzzles per fake — 100 fakes cost $2,000 and 250 hours. At each vertex the verifier issues a fresh random challenge answerable only within 90 seconds, and the plume of signed hop receipts proves the chain; hops are sequential, so a farm cannot parallelize or share one completed voyage across clones.
